REACHED THE GOAL.

What I did: added three tasks (two short ones and a full sentence about meeting notes), ticked "Buy groceries" as done, tried the Active and Completed filters, renamed "Call the dentist" to "Book dentist appointment", then removed everything.

What worked: adding a task with Enter or the Add button, the checkbox with strike-through, the "N left" counter, the per-row Delete button, and saving an edit by pressing Enter in the edit box.

What behaved differently from what I expected:
- Long tasks get cut off silently. I typed a sentence of roughly 130 characters. The list showed "Write up notes from the Tuesda", chopped mid-word with no ellipsis. Opening Edit and pressing End confirmed only the first 30 characters were kept. There was no warning or character counter. Oddly, the edit box then accepted a 48-character name and saved it, so the limit only applies when adding.
- The Save button does nothing. In edit mode I clicked Save three times across two tasks, with long and short text. The row stayed in edit mode with no message. Pressing Enter in the box saved every time. Someone who doesn't think to press Enter would conclude renaming is broken.
- Active and Completed are swapped. With one task ticked, Active showed only the ticked grocery task, and Completed showed the two unfinished ones. The "2 left" count was correct, so it's the filter buttons that are backwards.
- Clear completed does nothing. With one ticked task I clicked it twice and the task stayed. I had to use the row's Delete button instead.
- The empty list shows the word "undefined". Both on first load and after deleting everything, the list box shows "undefined" where I'd expect "No tasks yet" or a blank area.

Where I hesitated:
- When the long task appeared truncated, I couldn't tell whether it was a display cut-off or lost text. I had to open Edit to find out.
- When Save didn't respond, I assumed I'd missed the button and clicked again, then tried Enter as a last resort. Nothing on screen told me what was wrong.
- When Clear completed didn't respond, I assumed my click had landed during a redraw and tried once more before giving up on it.

Not verified: whether tasks survive a page reload (I never refreshed), and whether the cut-off is exactly 30 characters or varies.
